title: Tampa Bay OTT Advertising Company | Over The Top & CTV Marketing

facts.fact: The page describes OTT as video advertisements placed on streaming platforms such as Peacock, Pluto, Hulu, and Sling, among others.
facts.quote: OTT stands for Over the Top, which is just another way to say video advertisements that you place on streaming platforms like Peacock, Pluto, Hulu, Sling, and many others.

facts.fact: The vendor offers a free consultation, presented as a call to action on the page.
The vendor states that its 24/7 customer dashboard lets clients analyze and evaluate OTT campaign performance up to the second.
facts.quote: Our 24/7 customer dashboard gives you up-to-the-second ability to analyze and evaluate the performance of your OTT campaign.

facts.fact: The vendor claims it has worked with Fortune 500 companies as well as small local businesses.
facts.quote: We’ve worked with Fortune 500 companies, small local businesses, and everything in between with proven success.

facts.fact: The vendor lists Automotive and Credit Unions/Financial among the industries it serves.
The vendor lists a case study for Women's Refuge of Vero Beach.
The vendor's listed office address is in Scottsdale, Arizona.
The vendor's listed phone number is (866) 756-8975.
